First Bangkok visit; prefer unhurried independent wandering with a few pointers rather than packed days.
Loves Thai home cooking and fragrant Thai curries; severe peanut allergy.
Aisha reports no food restrictions for Tom.
Enjoys gardens and little architectural details; wants time to stop for photographs without holding a group up.
